steps.input:
# Extract for each demo the sequence of concentric frames (Manhattan-ring shells) with their colors.
# Frames: half-size H, H-2, H-4...; shell between frame k and frame k+1 (or outer<->frame1). Record colors of cells in each shell.
def shells(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    fr=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if inp[r][c]==5]
    rs=sorted(set(r for r,_ in fr)); cs=sorted(set(c for _,c in fr))
    R0,R1,C0,C1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    # frames at half-size H - 2k: border rows R0+k..R1-k, cols C0+k..C1-k
    K= (R1-R0)//2
    frames=[]
    for k in range(K+1):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=R0+k,R1-k,C0+k,C1-k
        frames.append((r0,r1,c0,c1))
    return frames
for n in (1,2,3,4):
    i_=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']
    fr=shells(i_)
    print('demo',n,'frames:',[(f[0]-f[2],f[1]-f[0]+1,f[3]-f[2]+1,f[0],f[1]) for f in fr])

# Understand coloring: for each interior cell of a frame, look at Manhattan distance from the frame border
def mindist_to_border(g, r0,r1,c0,c1):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    res=[]
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            if g[r][c]!=0: continue
            d=min(r-r0-1,(r1-r)-(r1-r0-2)) # vertical distance to nearest top/bottom edge
            dd=min(abs(c-c0-1),(c1-c)-(c1-c0-2))
            res.append(((r,c),d,dd,d+d,dd*max(1,abs(c-c0-1)-0),None))
    return res
# Simpler: print distance-to-nearest-frame-edge maps for each demo's interior
for n in (1,2,3,4):
    i=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; o=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    fr=frames(i)
    r0,r1,c0,c1=fr[0]
    print('=== demo',n)
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        line=''
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            d=min(abs(r-r0-1),abs(r-(r1-1))),0
            v=min(abs(r-r0-1), abs(r1-1-r), abs(c-c0-1), c1-1-c)
            line += str(v%2) if o[r][c]==(2 if v%2 else 5) else '?'
        print(line)
